meta.purpose: Primary app/bot avatar for a Telegram bot that repairs social media link previews
meta.usage_note: Paste this entire JSON as the prompt. Render the 'primary_concept'. The 'alternate_concepts' are only for regeneration if the primary is rejected - do not combine them into one image.

output_spec.format: PNG with transparent background, plus a solid-background variant
output_spec.safe_area: Keep all essential shapes within the central 84% of the canvas; Telegram crops avatars to a circle
output_spec.no_mockup_or_presentation_scene: Render the logo itself only - no business cards, phone screens, shadows on desks, or 'logo presentation' layouts

primary_concept.name: The Mended Link
primary_concept.one_line: A single chain link whose two halves close into the silhouette of a speech bubble.
primary_concept.narrative: The bot takes a broken link preview and makes it whole. The mark shows the exact moment two link halves connect - and the shape they form together is a chat bubble, placing the action inside a conversation.

construction.base_shape: Rounded square (squircle), corner radius 22% of side length, filled with the primary gradient
construction.foreground_symbol: A single horizontal chain link, centered, formed by two interlocking rounded-rectangle loops with generous stroke weight
construction.key_detail: The lower-left edge of the combined link silhouette extends into a small triangular tail, at roughly 7 o'clock, turning the whole form into a speech bubble
construction.symbol_treatment: Knocked out of the background (negative space) so the symbol reads as the canvas color, not as a separate colored object
construction.stroke_weight: Link stroke = 11% of the icon's inner width; identical weight on both loops, no tapering
construction.optical_centering: Shift the symbol up by ~2% of canvas height so the tail does not make it feel bottom-heavy

geometry_rules.grid: Construct on a 24x24 unit grid, all key points snapped to whole or half units
geometry_rules.curves: Circular arcs and straight segments only - no hand-drawn or irregular bezier wobble
geometry_rules.corner_radii: Every terminal is fully rounded (semicircular cap); no square or mitered corners anywhere
geometry_rules.symmetry: Horizontally symmetric except for the speech-bubble tail
geometry_rules.counters: The negative space inside each loop must stay open enough to remain visible at 32px - minimum counter width 8% of icon width

alternate_concepts.name: The Preview Card
alternate_concepts.one_line: A minimal embed/preview card outline with a play triangle, one corner reconnecting like a link.
alternate_concepts.when_to_use: If the chain-link mark reads too generically as a 'hyperlink' icon

alternate_concepts.name: The Spark Fix
alternate_concepts.one_line: A chain link with a small four-point sparkle at the joint, signalling the repair moment.
alternate_concepts.when_to_use: If a friendlier, more playful tone is wanted

color.strategy: Single vivid gradient background with a knocked-out symbol. High contrast, no more than two hues.

symbol_color.note: Pure white knockout; do not tint

accent_optional.name: Fixed Green
accent_optional.usage: At most one tiny accent at the link joint. Omit entirely if it adds noise.

forbidden: Drop shadows, outer glows, bevels, or emboss
Photographic textures, noise, grain, or paper texture
Skeuomorphic gloss or glassy highlight sweeps

style.family: Modern flat vector, geometric, app-icon discipline
style.reference_register: The visual restraint of contemporary system app icons - confident, minimal, immediately readable
style.line_quality: Uniform weight, mathematically clean, optically corrected
style.dimensionality: Strictly flat. No 3D, no isometric, no perspective, no gradient on the symbol itself
style.complexity_budget: A viewer should be able to redraw the mark from memory after three seconds

variants_requested.description: Full color gradient background, white knockout symbol
Transparent background, solid #1179C9 symbol, no container shape
Pure black symbol on transparent, for stamping and favicons

trademark: Do NOT draw, echo, or stylize the Telegram paper-plane logo or any part of Telegram's official branding
Do NOT include the Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X/Twitter, Bluesky, or Facebook logos, glyphs, or brand colors
The mark must be original and not derivative of any existing company's identity
content: No letters, words, numerals, or wordmark of any kind
No human figures, hands, faces, or mascots
No robot imagery - 'bot' is a technical role here, not a character
composition: Exactly one mark, centered, filling roughly 80% of the frame
No grid of variations, no colorway sheet, no multiple icons in one image
No background scene, environment, or decorative particles

quality_checklist: Silhouette is distinguishable when filled solid black at 32x32
Symbol counters remain open and unclogged at small size
No element touches the outer 8% margin of the canvas
Stroke weights are visually identical across the whole mark
Mark still reads correctly when cropped to a circle
Mark still reads correctly in pure monochrome
compact_prompt_fallback: A 1:1 flat vector app icon on a squircle with a 135-degree gradient from #37BBFE to #1179C9. Centered inside, knocked out in pure white, is a single geometric chain link made of two interlocking rounded loops of uniform heavy stroke; the combined silhouette extends into a small triangular tail at the lower left, making the whole form read as a speech bubble. Strictly flat, no shadows, no gloss, no text, no 3D, no existing brand logos. Clean, minimal, readable at 32 pixels. Transparent background outside the squircle.
